considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points via the extensive paved parking surround the building. The parking lots provide substantial space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Multiple vehicles and outdoor equipment currently occupy portions of the site. Trees and landscaping are present but do not fully obstruct access. The industrial layout includes outdoor storage areas that may require additional navigation awareness. Neighboring industrial and commercial facilities are present.
